summary: Tuesday morning flow, PlayerBag, ActivityBar, Harvest, Well, StatusModal - large feature set tested via UI automation with AsyncStorage state injection. All core flows verified. One stale-closure bug found in bucket gift resume path.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale closure bug: when loading garden in TUTORIAL_HARVEST_COMPLETE resume state, startBucketGiftFlow() is called from useEffect with stale playerBag (DEFAULT_BAG, unlocked:false). The bucket is added correctly but the saved bag has unlocked:false, causing bag icon to show lock after bucket gift in resume scenario.
ui_bugs.reproduction: Set @garden:has_harvested_tutorial_herbs=true, @garden:activity_bar_unlocked not set, @game:player_bag with unlocked:true. Load garden. Dismiss bucket gift bubble. Check @game:player_bag - unlocked will be false.
ui_bugs.fix: Use a playerBagRef (useRef kept in sync via useEffect) and reference playerBagRef.current inside startBucketGiftFlow instead of the closure-captured playerBag state.

action_items: Fix stale closure in garden.tsx startBucketGiftFlow(): use playerBagRef.current instead of playerBag from closure. Add playerBagRef = useRef(DEFAULT_BAG) and sync it in useEffect when playerBag changes.

rca_of_issue: Bug: startBucketGiftFlow captures playerBag from React closure at time of useEffect execution. When called from useEffect (resume path), playerBag is still DEFAULT_BAG (unlocked:false) because setState calls are async and haven't re-rendered yet. Fix: add `const playerBagRef = useRef<PlayerBagData>(DEFAULT_BAG); useEffect(() => { playerBagRef.current = playerBag; }, [playerBag]);` and use `playerBagRef.current` inside startBucketGiftFlow.
